purpose: Experiment E-MTH-0012 in the method arena: one omega, measured: left multiplication by a Hurwitz cube root of unity is the center of the bulk's U(2), its orbits on the 24 root directions are exactly the 32 zero-sum triangles (knot = momentum closure), on each of its 4 kept color planes it is the generation cycle times the color cycle, and its invariant states all have charge 0 mod 3 (the lock); but no knit in the repo keeps any fixed-point-free order-3 element, so the same-omega rule is a constraint no current knit meets.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
